$description: Token proposals for KeyboardShortcut (carbon-labs v12). Moves to packages/themes at graduation. Colour values are OKLCH: `carbon.themes` holds the per-theme value, `com.ibm.harness.curve` the colour family and lightness rule it was derived from, and `com.ibm.harness.fallback` the pinned sRGB hex for non-P3 displays.

keycap-inverse.$description: The keycap fill inside a high-contrast popover (Tooltip, DefinitionTooltip, IconButton label): one 0.04 step past the popover ground (background-inverse, L 0.345 light, 0.967 dark), darker in both. Carbon's background-inverse-hover is lighter than the ground in the light theme and only read as a key through a border, which the keycap no longer draws. $text-inverse on it is 13.4:1 light and 13.0:1 dark.
